front.title: Card-Scheme Dispute Evidence Profile of Signed Decision Receipts

abstract.t: This document profiles draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts, "Signed Decision Receipts for Machine-to-Machine Access Control", for use as card-scheme dispute evidence. It defines how a conforming decision receipt is populated for payment disputes, and specifies four additional evidence layers bound to that receipt: card-scheme dispute-evidence categories (Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0, Mastercard First-Party Trust), agent-native anchors with no scheme-defined slot, a settlement anchor recording what money actually moved, and an evidentiary-custody wrapper aligned with U.S. Federal Rules of Evidence 901/902. This is a vendor profile documenting one implementation (ActaSeal's DisputeEvidencePacket); it does not define a new protocol and makes no claim of IETF consensus or standardization.
